crossRefs.note: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up…
Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out…
“Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you…
Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
translations.bsb: “Master,” Simon replied, “we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.”
translations.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
translations.asv: And Simon answered and said, Master, we toiled all night, and took nothing: but at thy word I will let down the nets.
